opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one; £28,000 in years two and three; up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate; must not be in a permanent post; UK residency; UK university post required.
opportunities.summary: Supports early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, providing salary contributions and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and eligible UK independent research institutes/organisations; applicants must hold a post at an eligible institution; research must be innovative and original; excludes medical/clinical research.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects up to five years, covering staff costs and associated research expenses.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) must coordinate the visit; host institution must approve; applicants must not have held a Visiting Professorship in the previous 7 years.
opportunities.summary: Invites eminent senior professors from overseas to undertake a 3‑12 month visit, enhancing skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers with a UK university post that extends beyond the fellowship; must be resident in the UK; must have been prevented by routine duties from completing research.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers to complete a piece of original research, with up to three years tenure.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers resident in the UK, with a UK university or eligible research institute post; must have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Allows retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs covered; research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in humanities and social sciences; must hold a UK university post; not previously awarded a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Supports distinguished researchers to complete a piece of original research, typically for two or three years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (single or collaborative) with research degree awarding powers; can include international partners; outline applications close June 2027.
opportunities.summary: Supports large‑scale research centres aiming for step‑change scholarship across any discipline (excluding medical/clinical research).
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine and performing arts training for school‑age children under 18.
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school‑age children outside regular school hours, covering tuition, maintenance, equipment, travel, etc.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities providing bursaries to undergraduate or postgraduate arts students.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate arts students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent); must have at least two years post‑PhD experience; cannot have held an equivalent award or large project grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career scholars to build a research team and demonstrate research leadership over 4‑5 years.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)
